sentences: Here's every part inside your PC, and what it actually does, in under a minute.
The power supply turns wall power into clean, low-voltage power.
The motherboard connects everything, like the roads of a city.
It runs billions of tiny instructions every second.
The GPU is a crowd of thousands of small cores that draws every frame you see.
It keeps your files when the power is off.
It's fast, but it forgets everything when you shut down.
And the coolers pull heat away so none of it slows down.
Want to see it all working together?
The full animated breakdown is on the channel.
